assertions: Every bundle contains exactly all six canonical transcript views.
Every view preserves utterance identifiers and source intervals.
Unknown and conflicting speakers remain explicit.
Interruption, continuation, overlap, quotation, source, repair, uncertainty, and review evidence is rendered as markers.
The overlap-expanded view preserves temporal groups and lanes.
Sequential overlap linearization and unavailable label or text surfaces produce sealed loss records.
Persistence is deterministic, reloadable, cache-safe, and tamper-evident.
CLI operations build, validate, inspect, list, and render transcript views.
limitations: Synthetic fixtures qualify mechanics rather than speaker-attribution accuracy.
Presentation views do not replace the utterance corpus or upstream evidence.
Compact and sequential views cannot express simultaneous speech spatially; declared losses preserve that limitation.
